div.div: حَزِيزٌ Rugged ground: (IDrd:) or a rugged and extended place: (S, K:) or a place abounding with rugged stones like knives: or hard ground in a tract abounding with pebbles: (TA:) or rugged and hard ground with a slight elevation: (ISh:) or depressed ground: (TA:) pl. [of pauc.] أَحِزَّةٌ and [of mult.] حِزَّانٌ (S, K) and حُزَّانٌ and حُزُزٌ, (K, TA,) with two dammehs, (TA,) or حُزَزٌ. (CK.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
